title: Game
description: Game contract shared by all platforms: presentation (genre, orientation, palette, world) and the deterministic runtime (simulation, input, entity kinds, spawners, collisions). Runtime semantics: architecture/RUNTIME-CONTRACT.md.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Locked screen orientation (Android screenOrientation, iOS UISupportedInterfaceOrientations).

targetFps.description: Target frame rate for the render loop. The simulation tick rate is independent (simulation.tickRate).

world.title: World
world.description: Logical world size in world units. Platforms scale it to fit the screen. The runtime requires whole units no larger than 32767.

input.title: InputConfig
input.description: Which input events the game uses and how they act. Quantities are Q16.16 raw integers (1 unit = 65536).

dragGain.description: Multiplier applied to a drag delta (65536 = 1.0).

swipeSpeed.description: Speed per tick given to controlled entities by a swipe.

tapKind.description: Entity kind spawned by a tap at the first controlled entity, or the empty string for none.

tapVx.description: Horizontal velocity of a tap-spawned entity.

tapVy.description: Vertical velocity of a tap-spawned entity.

maxTicksPerFrame.description: Upper bound on ticks run for one rendered frame.

runtime.title: GameRuntime
runtime.description: Entity kinds, initial entities, spawners and collision rules. Every position and velocity is a Q16.16 raw integer; velocities are per tick.

maxEntities.description: Upper bound on live entities; spawns beyond it are skipped.

lives.description: Starting lives; the game ends when lives reach 0.

winScore.description: The game ends when the score reaches this value; 0 disables it.

lifetimeTicks.description: Despawn after this many ticks; 0 means unlimited.

exitPolicy.title: ExitRule
exitPolicy.description: What happens at the world edge: despawn when fully outside, clamp inside, or bounce.

items.title: Spawner
items.description: Spawns one entity every intervalTicks ticks (tick 0 included) at a PRNG-chosen position in [xMin,xMax] x [yMin,yMax].

stream.description: Name of the independent PRNG stream this spawner draws from.

items.title: CollisionEffect
items.description: Applies to every overlapping pair (a, b); effects are summed per tick, so pair order never matters.

score.description: Added to the score for each overlapping pair.

lives.description: Added to the lives for each overlapping pair.

fixed.description: Q16.16 fixed-point raw integer (1.0 = 65536), saturating int32 range.

kindId.description: Lowercase ASCII identifier: a letter, then letters, digits or hyphens (at most 32 characters).

kindRef.description: An entity kind id, or the empty string for none.
